title: Live Payment Gateway Cryptographic Webhook & Anti-Fraud Idempotency Hardening
objective: Harden live payment webhook verifiers for bKash, SSLCommerz, and Stripe with HMAC SHA-256 signature validation, persistent idempotency locks against double billing, and automated reconciliation of pending transactions.
in_scope: Implement HMAC SHA-256 signature verification in server/services/paymentProviders.ts and routes/billing.ts.
Add atomic idempotency lock in server/services/subscriptionService.ts to prevent concurrent duplicate activations.
Author automated verification test scripts/test-payment-webhook-security.ts verifying replay protection and signature checks.
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
out_of_scope: Changing client-side checkout modal visual branding.
acceptance_criteria: Payment webhooks reject invalid or missing HMAC cryptographic signatures with 400/401.
Duplicate webhook notifications with identical transaction ID are safely deduplicated (idempotent 200 OK without re-charging).
Tampered price amounts are rejected immediately.
Automated payment security test passes 100% of assertions.
risks: Network timeouts during third-party gateway verification (mitigated by exponential backoff retry in worker queue).
